- Contribute to key research studies to better understand user behaviors, needs, and motivations in the digital payments space.
- Work cross-functionally with teams across Amazon to ensure cohesive design implementation and alignment with broader company goals.

title: Senior PMT, Payment Experiences, Amazon Pay
jobDescription:
Amazon Pay is redefining how customers pay
- on Amazon, across the internet, and at the doorstep. We are looking for a Product Manager III
- Tech to lead payment experiences across three critical areas: Digital Pay on Delivery (DPOD), checkout for internal Amazon group entity merchants, and agentic/AI-led commerce. In this role, you will own the DPOD product end-to-end driving success rates, scaling digital adoption, and making Amazon Pay the default digital payment option for pay-on-delivery customers. You will also build Amazon Pay's checkout as a full-stack experience for merchants, partner with Amazon group entities (AWS, Kindle, Audible) to unify payment experiences contributing ~$10M+ in revenue, and define how payments work in emerging AI-driven experiences including agent-initiated commerce. This is a high-impact role for a builder who thrives at the intersection of payments, platform strategy, and cutting-edge technology. Key job responsibilities
- Own Digital Pay on Delivery (DPOD) Payment Experience i.e. drive success rates, optimize PSP stack performance, and improve the customer payment experience at the doorstep
- Scale DPOD adoption i.e. grow the DPOD customer cohort by identifying conversion barriers, running experiments, and partnering with delivery, risk, and operations teams to increase digital payment penetration for COD customers
- Own and drive Amazon Pay's checkout as a full-stack experience, and scale adoption across large enterprises and long-tail merchants. Improve checkout conversion rates and make Amazon Pay the preferred checkout layer for merchants
- Partner with Amazon group entities (AWS, Kindle, Audible, etc.) to design and deliver a unified payment experience, targeting ~$10M+ in revenue contribution
- Define the product vision for next-gen payment experiences in agentic and AI-led commerce, enabling seamless agent-initiated transactions across Amazon and external ecosystems
- Drive alignment across emerging markets on ownership and scalable global expansion of payment CX for payment rails in emerging markets
- Own end-to-end execution across technology, business, GTM, risk, and compliance to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions About the team Amazon Pay is on a mission to make payments effortless everywhere customers shop, including at their doorstep. Our team builds payment experiences that serve hundreds of millions of customers across Amazon's ecosystem and beyond. We are driving the shift from cash-on-delivery to digital payments through Digital Pay-On-Delivery, while simultaneously defining how payments work in the age of AI and agentic commerce. We operate with a startup mindset inside Amazon -moving fast, thinking big, and delivering results that matter. We value ownership, customer obsession, and a bias for action. Our team is based in Bengaluru and works closely with global teams across Amazon Pay, emerging markets, and Amazon group entities.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Pay
jobDescription:
Want to be part of a dynamic start-up environment within Amazon and be at the forefront of enabling "Amazon Pay" outside of Amazon? Our team is looking for passionate, experienced software developer who can deliver high quality platform solutions to support our customers (buyers and merchants) enabling "Amazon Pay" to scale as the universal wallet for all of Amazon buyers. As an engineer in Amazon Pay, you will be part of a dynamic team working on complex problems innovating on behalf of our customers. As an SDE II, you will play a key role in building a world-class, frictionless payments solution and merchant experience that helps us scale while retaining customer and merchant trust. This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technology teams, working alongside some of the industry's top engineers. You will have access to mentoring programs, regular tech talks with principal engineers, and opportunities to develop your skills and advance your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies. If you're passionate about building transformative payment solutions that enable merchants and delight customers, we encourage you to apply. Come join us as we work hard, have Fun and make History! Key job responsibilities
- Deliver high-quality platform solutions supporting diverse customer and merchant use cases for Amazon Pay
- Develop and enhance web-based applications and web services that enable third-party merchants to integrate Amazon Pay
- Design and build large-scale, distributed systems to handle high-volume transactions in a 24/7 environment
- Contribute to the architecture, design, and evolution of new and existing systems focusing on reliability, scalability, and performance About the team Amazon Pay, one of the fastest growing businesses of Amazon, enables e-commerce websites to accept, and customers to utilise the payment information stored in their Amazon.com accounts to pay for goods and services at sites off-Amazon. Amazon Pay also enables customers to manage their account preferences and see their off-Amazon transactions. Hundreds of thousands of Users make millions of transactions worldwide on Amazon Pay. We develop software at every level of the stack from front-end user interfaces to backend server software and everything in between.

jobDescription: Are you passionate about driving strategic partnerships in the banking sector? Join our team at Amazon Pay as a Business Development Manager focused on banking partnerships in India. You'll conceptualize, pitch, and execute key programs with major banks, directly impacting the success of various Amazon.in businesses. This role offers exposure to senior leaders both at Amazon and in the Indian banking ecosystem. Your strategic thinking and relationship-building skills will be crucial in shaping the future of digital payments in India. We work closely with major financial institutions to create seamless, customer-centric payment solutions. Our team thrives on innovation, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex partnerships. We're passionate about making a tangible impact on how millions of customers in India transact online and in-store.

He/She will work very closely with operations team to identify blockers, come up with solutions and collaborate for roll-out of new initiatives. Engaging with Program teams is crucial for partner incentives and communication, while collaboration with the finance team is necessary for managing the FCF of the programs. jobDescription: This role is for Sr Risk Analyst who will play a critical role in AML transaction monitoring process and will be responsible for review of escalated alerts and filing suspicious transaction reports with the reporting authorities. The incumbent will report directly to the Sr Risk Manager. The Job will entail the following: a. Review of potential suspicious transactions and conducting deep dives b. Suspicious transaction reporting (STR) templatization for onward filing to regulators c. handling of inquiries received from regulators d. allocation and tracking of AML trainings e. managing customer risk categorization process f. tracking adherence to defined AML transaction monitoring process Risk and Compliance continue to evolve and incumbent could be expected to work and manage new programs as per organizational priority. About the team Our vision is to make Amazon Pay as the most trusted, convenient and rewarding Payment Experience. Given the highly sensitive nature of Payments business, it is imperative to have robust Risk and Compliance function, to ensure adherence to regulatory compliance and risk management and that's where Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) fits in. Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) is responsible for operational and compliance risk management for all functions within Amazon Pay. The function is responsible for setting strong operational risk management framework, risk identification, assessment and continuous monitoring framework. In addition, the function also manages key regulatory compliance functions such as regulatory reporting, Anti money laundering program, External Audit engagements, and Governances.

title: Sr. Product Manager, IN Payments
jobDescription: Our teams strive to make Amazon Pay the most rewarding and convenient place to fulfill their everyday needs on travel, financial services, build wealth, and much more. We are the Merchant Categories team within India Payments, responsible for creating and operating a collection of products and services that enable seamless transactions throughout Amazon Pay's ecosystem. The Merchant Categories team partners with leading merchants across diverse verticals-including travel, financial services and lifestyle-to deliver innovative solutions. We work at the intersection of payments, merchant partnerships, and customer experience, creating opportunities to differentiate Amazon Pay in India's rapidly evolving digital payments landscape. Our mission is to build the most convenient and rewarding platform while delivering exceptional value to customers through strategic category partnerships. We are looking for an experienced Product leader who will drive strategic initiatives and product launches across multiple merchant categories. This role requires a professional with strong cross-functional collaboration skills who can work effectively with internal Amazon teams and external merchant partners to deliver innovative payment solutions. and inform product decisions Cross-Functional Leadership 1) Drive joint initiatives and launches between multiple internal teams at Amazon (Tech, Payments, Business Development, Marketing, Operations) and external merchant partners 2) Build and maintain strong relationships with merchant partners, understanding their business models, customer pain points, and requirements 3) Collaborate with Business Development teams to structure partnership agreements that align product capabilities with commercial terms Product Development & Execution 1) Write detailed product requirements documents Management 1) Serve as the primary product point of contact for merchant partners, addressing escalations and ensuring smooth operations 2) Present product strategy and performance updates to senior leadership 3) Influence and align diverse stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and compliance teams 4) Navigate complex trade-offs between competing priorities and stakeholder needs Customer & Merchant Obsession 1) Deeply understand customer payment preferences 2) Use data, customer feedback, and merchant insights to drive continuous product improvements 3) Ensure payment solutions deliver value to both customers and merchants while maintaining operational excellence

title: Business Analyst II
jobDescription:
Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk. VRMO designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant. We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets. We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data. Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, Quick Sight/Tableau/Power BI and scripting languages (Python/Java Script) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess. Key job responsibilities • Organisation skills
- demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately. • Communication skills
- ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories • Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation • Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau • Ability to translate ambiguous work-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks. • Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.

title: Associate Vice President, Credit Risk, Amazon 1P Lending - Risk
jobDescription:
Are you passionate about empowering millions of customers to access credit responsibly and with confidence? Do you thrive on solving complex risk challenges that directly shape lending decisions at scale? Do you believe that data is the new oil
- and love turning it into insights that fuel smarter credit decisions? Come join us at Amazon 1P Lending
- Risk! Our team is at the heart of Amazon's mission to make credit accessible, responsible, and seamless for customers across the globe. We design and manage the credit risk frameworks that power lending products loved by millions
- from Pay Later to EMI solutions and beyond. We are part of Amazon's broader Amazon Pay organization, dedicated to building innovative financial products that are trusted, inclusive, and designed to put customers first
- anytime, anywhere. We are looking for a strategic and analytical Credit Risk Manager to join our Risk Management Team, with a strong understanding of risk management principles and proficiency in data management and manipulation tools such as SQL, Python, and Excel. You will design and implement scalable risk governance frameworks that engage with customers throughout their loan lifecycle
- from acquisition to customer management
- enabling lending operations to run efficiently at scale within a defined risk appetite. This is a high-visibility role that requires strong operational rigor, cross-functional collaboration with Product, Collections, Finance, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams, and the ability to communicate clearly to a variety of internal and external audiences. Key job responsibilities • Own end-to-end delivery of Risk Initiatives aligned to broader Team objectives. • Design, maintain, and update risk mitigation policies and controls across all customer interactions
- onboarding journey, credit and fraud underwriting, and customer lifecycle management • Create and own a lending portfolio governance framework, including data models and reports, leveraging SQL, Python, Excel, and dashboarding tools • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify potential risks and propose solutions, maintaining risk appetite and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements • Communicate complex operational findings and strategic recommendations clearly to a variety of internal and external audiences, including senior leadership A day in the life On any given day, you'll use SQL, Python, and Excel to build and validate credit strategies, oversee their implementation, and monitor performance. You'll own risk dashboards and reports that track the lending portfolio's health. A significant part of your day involves working cross-functionally as the risk representative-providing inputs from product build through deployment to post-go-live management, co-owning risk KPIs. You'll also engage in stakeholder management through regular reviews-within Risk and with broader CFTs. No two days look the same, but every day demands a balance of analytical rigor, strategic thinking, and effective communication. About the team As part of the Risk team, we own all activities that directly impact the P&L risk line items. We design and maintain credit underwriting policies for loan-seeking customers, and manage the entire credit lifecycle-from disbursal through collections. We partner with data science teams to embed ML-driven risk models into our policy frameworks, and collaborate closely with product management to shape the lending product while mitigating process and fraud risks.

title: Snr Data Analytics Manager, SWOTS [VRMO]
jobDescription:
We detect and prevent fraud among hundreds of millions of e-Commerce transactions in different countries. We create a trusted store where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online. What kinds of processes and systems would you build to optimize our data analytics and MIS? About the Team: We are a highly diverse team comprising individuals from various backgrounds who ensure Amazon continues to remain a safe place for our selling partners to do business on our platform. We welcome professionals who are open to new ideas and perspectives. Our team's strength lies in our ability to leverage our diverse experiences and expertise to drive innovation and solve complex challenges. We value collaboration, creativity, and a willingness to embrace different viewpoints. At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and Gen AI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate
- from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop fast-paced AI fluency, with continuous learning built into the culture. Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Data Analytics Leader with a passion for analyzing data and surfacing key insights that drive strategic shifts and business decisions. Operating with significant autonomy and discretion, you will drive the development of solutions to some of the company's most challenging business issues and help scale the network rapidly and safely with your strategy. You must be curious, willing to try, to learn, and to collaborate with a high-performing team. In this role, you will focus on strategy and storytelling, i.e., deciding what to measure, why it matters, and what action to take. You will build and own measurement frameworks that translate operational workflow signals, multi-channel content performance data, and business patterns into narratives and recommendations. You will lead recurring strategy sessions, write analytical narratives for global business reviews, build AI-powered automation that reduces manual reporting burden, and surface insights at scale using dashboards, Python, and intelligent agents. You will manage relationships across a global team of technical and non-technical strategists and upstream partners (data engineers, business intelligence engineers) who support our data infrastructure. You will represent findings to senior leadership and partner cross-functionally to innovate on how we reach and engage our workforce effectively. This role requires someone who thinks critically and probabilistically
- exploring what data might mean rather than jumping to conclusions
- and who can build scalable systems from ambiguity. We look for candidates who are excellent communicators, self-motivated, flexible, smart-working, and like to make history
- and have fun doing it! Key job responsibilities > Define and execute the data analytics strategy aligned to operational goals, delivering insights that drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, and performance > Improve data accuracy of key business metrics and optimize process flows that strengthen the organization's data pipeline and upstream tables > Drive implementation of new tools, models, and AI-powered automation that reduce manual reporting burden and scale analytical impact > Build measurement frameworks, write compelling business documents, develop data visualizations, and deliver analytical narratives for global business reviews > Lead and develop a team of Business Analysts and Program Managers; set clear goals, provide coaching, and create career development pathways > Partner with senior operations leaders to identify opportunities, frame analytical questions, and deliver data-driven recommendations > Manage relationships across global technical and non-technical teams; represent findings to senior leadership and drive action on insights > Contribute to program and functional growth through innovation, benchmarking, and scalable solutions delivering measurable cost savings or efficiency gains through analytics About the team VRMO
- Our globe of Operations {Verification & Risk Management Ops]: Here, we verify identity of all the selling partners who sells on Amazon. We comply with the Amazon Pay regulatory requirements through our verification bar and we proactively detect bad actors and eliminate them from our ecosystem. SWOTS
- Strategic Workforce Optimization & Tactical Solutions: Anchoring centrally all key business support programs, enabling the VRMO (and SPIV) organization through operational excellence owning 7 key capabilities i) Forecasting, ii) HC Planning, OPEX Budgeting (GPSS) and WFM, iii) Data Analytics & MIS (CIA), iv) Data Security, v) BCP, and vi) 3P Outsourcing and Vendor cost governance.
